value_stream.name: B2B Bulk-Project Custom Import (Indent Sourcing & Brokerage Operations)

fields.Participants: Key Account Manager, Customer Project Design Specialist (VS-66), Technical Standards Officer (VS-117)
fields.Trigger: B2B key account customer submits request for custom/bulk imported materials (VS-107, VS-11)

workflows.name: B2B Project Custom Sourcing Intake and Specifications Scoping

Automation Opportunity: - Customer portal for uploading design assets and CAD drawings directly linked to custom item module.
Controls: - CTL-776 (ensure controlled execution — Custom Project Sourcing Intake & Quotation (PA-182.1).)
- operational: vendor compliance check at indent intake, technical compliance verification sign-off required prior to RFQ launch.
Cross-references: - links to VS-11 (trade project), VS-107 (key account), VS-66 (design services), VS-117 (DTI-BPS)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Specification drift risk**: Customer specs change mid-process leading to incorrect orders; mitigated by sign-off gate in step 3.
System Touchpoints: - B2B CRM module (VS-11), custom specification master (VS-29), project estimation module (VS-66).

steps.activity: Receive custom material specifications from client.
Review technical feasibility and local regulatory compliance (BPS standards) with Technical Standards Officer.
Define final technical scope, packaging requirements, and target jobsite delivery dates.
Upload specifications sheet to ERP custom sourcing module.

fields.Participants: B2B Sourcing Manager, Global Sourcing Agent (VS-122), Quality Inspector (VS-31)

workflows.name: Overseas Supplier RFQ Factory Vetting and Sample Approval

Automation Opportunity: - Automatic RFQ distribution and tracking system across registered import vendor panel.
Controls: - CTL-776 (ensure controlled execution — Custom Project Sourcing Intake & Quotation (PA-182.1).)
- operational: indent import quality & document control; Quality Manager sign-off on test results required.
Cross-references: - links to VS-122 (global sourcing), VS-31 (quality management)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sample non-conformance risk**: Imported production materials differ from approved prototype; mitigated by retaining signed master samples in DC vault.
System Touchpoints: - Global Sourcing Portal (VS-122), Quality Management Module (VS-31).
Time Estimate: - ~10-15 working days lead time for overseas sample receipt and testing

steps.activity: Identify qualified overseas suppliers and transmit RFQ package.
Review factory capability and ISO/accreditation records with Global Sourcing Agent.
Request prototype/production samples and track air-freight delivery.
Conduct physical and structural testing on received samples; issue sample evaluation report.

fields.Participants: Import Buyer, Category Manager (VS-01.2), Freight Coordinator (VS-110)

workflows.name: Project Landing Cost Calculation Pricing and Margin Matrix Modeling

Automation Opportunity: - Automated API integration with logistics carriers for real-time freight and fuel surcharge updates.
Controls: - CTL-15: Ensure accurate landed cost on imports; VP Merchandising approval gate.
Cross-references: - links to VS-158 (product costing), VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-110 (freight), VS-87 (tariffs)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost underestimation risk**: Fluctuating ocean freight rates or tariff classifications erode planned margins; mitigated by utilizing real-time freight indexes and obtaining binding tariff rulings (VS-87).

steps.activity: Gather FOB pricing, ocean freight rates, insurance, drayage, and customs tariff estimates.
Input variables to Landed Cost Calculator; estimate duties, VAT, brokerage fees, and port charges.
Apply margin matrix matching B2B project guidelines (target gross margin >=18% for custom bulk).
Generate project pricing proposal and submit to VP Merchandising for approval.

fields.Participants: Key Account Manager, VP Legal (VS-100), B2B Sourcing Manager
fields.Trigger: Approved pricing proposal (W5227) and customer intent to purchase

workflows.name: Custom Indent Sourcing Contract Drafting and Legal Signing

Automation Opportunity: - Legal template generation library with auto-filling product specification fields.
Controls: - CTL-776 (ensure controlled execution — Custom Project Sourcing Intake & Quotation (PA-182.1).)
- operational: indent import quality & document control; contract sign-off per Board limit matrix.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Liquidated damages risk**: Import delays trigger client-imposed financial penalties; mitigated by building a 15-day buffer into contract delivery dates.
System Touchpoints: - Legal Contract Management System (VS-100), B2B Account Portal.
Time Estimate: - ~5-10 working days for legal reviews and negotiation

steps.activity: Draft customized project indent agreement incorporating technical specs, lead times, payment milestones, and liquidated damages clauses.
Review legal terms (warranty, liability, force majeure) with VP Legal.
Negotiate contract adjustments with customer's legal team.
Execute contract signing (digital or physical notarization).

fields.Participants: Key Account Manager, Cashier (VS-08.1), AR Clerk (VS-16)

workflows.name: Custom Order Pro-Forma Invoice Generation and Downpayment Collection

Automation Opportunity: - Automated bank payment notification matching pro-forma reference numbers.
Controls: - CTL-12: Separate credit approval from sales execution; CTL-19 (Ensure bank reconciliation completeness).
Cross-references: - links to VS-16 (O2C), VS-18 (treasury), VS-173 (investor relations)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Payment default risk**: Order sent to production before downpayment clears, creating cash exposure; mitigated by enforcing automated system production-lock until deposit clears.
System Touchpoints: - Billing Module, AR Module (VS-16), Bank Reconciliation (VS-18).

steps.activity: Generate pro-forma invoice in ERP matching contract milestones (typically 30% downpayment).
Transmit invoice to customer and track payment window (typically 5 business days).
Process downpayment collection (bank transfer, check, or escrow release).
Verify payment clearance in bank reconciliation and release order for production.

fields.Participants: B2B Sourcing Manager, Import Buyer, Supplier Quality Liaison

workflows.name: Indent Order Technical Review and Production Quality Agreement Setup

Automation Opportunity: - Standardized bilingual Quality Agreement template generator.
Controls: - CTL-776 (ensure controlled execution — Custom Project Sourcing Intake & Quotation (PA-182.1).)
- operational: vendor-panel control at intake; QA Director approval of quality agreements.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Quality standard mismatch risk**: Foreign factory uses alternative testing standards not recognized by local authorities; mitigated by mandating ISO/IEC 17025 accredited third-party testing in agreement.

steps.activity: Conduct final technical specification sanity check with supplier engineering team.
Draft Quality Agreement detailing inspection criteria, AQL thresholds, and testing methods.
Transmit Quality Agreement to factory for signature.
Confirm factory receipt and execute signed Quality Agreement in ERP.

fields.Owner: Supplier Quality Liaison / Global Sourcing Coordinator

workflows.name: Production Scheduling and Weekly Factory Progress Verification

Automation Opportunity: - Supplier self-service portal update reminders with automated milestone alerts.
Controls: - CTL-74 (ensure indent import quality & document control.)
- operational: milestone validation controls; weekly status updates signed off by VP Supply Chain.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Production delay risk**: Unreported factory bottlenecks delay shipping window; mitigated by weekly visual validation of production logs and raw materials receipt.
Time Estimate: - ~3.5 hours weekly per active production order

steps.a: Supplier Quality Liaison / Global Sourcing Coordinator
steps.activity: Request weekly production status report and photo/video evidence from supplier.

steps.a: Supplier Quality Liaison / Global Sourcing Coordinator
steps.activity: Verify production milestone dates (raw material cutting, assembly, finishing).

steps.a: Supplier Quality Liaison / Global Sourcing Coordinator
steps.activity: Escalate potential production delays to Sourcing Manager and adjust timeline projections.

steps.a: Supplier Quality Liaison / Global Sourcing Coordinator
steps.activity: Update project dashboard in ERP with current ETA projections.

fields.Participants: Supplier Quality Liaison, Third-Party Inspector, B2B Sourcing Manager

workflows.name: Pre-Shipment Inspection Coordination and Quality Gate Sign-off

Automation Opportunity: - Automatic inspection trigger upon supplier production milestone closure.
Controls: - CTL-776 (ensure controlled execution — Custom Project Sourcing Intake & Quotation (PA-182.1).)
- operational: receiving-fraud gate on indent shipments; QA Director formal sign-off on PSI reports.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Defect container release risk**: Defective materials loaded into shipping containers before inspection is finalized; mitigated by requiring shipping lines to verify BuildRight's Quality Release Certificate before releasing empty containers to factory.
System Touchpoints: - Quality Module (VS-31), Supplier Portal (VS-03), shipping module (VS-110).
Time Estimate: - ~3-5 working days for inspector dispatch and report analysis

steps.activity: Schedule third-party inspection (SGS, TUV, Bureau Veritas) at foreign factory location.
Review Pre-Shipment Inspection (PSI) report against specifications and approved samples.
Issue "Release for Shipment" certificate in ERP upon satisfactory PSI report.
Authorize final container booking request with logistics partners.
